objective: Find early crypto momentum/pumping candidates by detecting abnormal capital inflow before promoting them to ORION research.
workflow: Read Volume Flow and Net Flow.
Rank coins by positive net inflow and recent flow acceleration.
Prefer persistent inflow across multiple timeframes and fresh rotation into the asset.
Inspect the coin chart for price/volume confirmation and avoid already-exhausted moves.
Cross-check liquidity/spread, open interest, long-short ratio, whale trades and broader market conditions.
Send validated candidates to ORION RESEARCH -> CROSS-CHECK -> RISK. Never trade from flow alone.
output: DISCOVERY candidate only; promotion requires independent evidence and risk review.
